description.text: Introduction This program could be taught both in English and Chinese. Master students could choose to be taught in Chinese or English language based on their own situation, and their degree dissertation could be chosen to be written in Chinese or English. Teaching Objectives The program is for candidates with science and engineering backgrounds who have the drive to: • Lead technology development and engineering • Create new technology-enabled ventures • Develop business technology strategies • Design policies to encourage technological innovation Study Duration Semester1: September to next January Winter Vacation: January and February Semester2: March to July Summer Vacation: July and August Degree Award Students are required to complete the curriculum in 2.5, fulfill the designated degree courses, complete the master's thesis and defend of it in front of a panel of experts. Graduates will receive a graduation certificate along with the Master’s degree. Career The E&TIM program equips students for meaningful careers as leaders in innovation and the strategic management of technology.

duration.text: The Innovation Engineering and Management at Wuhan University of Technology is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2916 USD/per year ￥ 21000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6.Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months)

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese 2. Who haven’t broken laws 3. Have bachelor degree.
